articles.title: Security Experts Want the US and China to Promise Never to Let AI Control Nukes
articles.description: Brookings researchers in the US and China are urging Washington and Beijing to agree to keep humans in control of nuclear weapons.

articles.title: Your Data Could Outlive the Startup You Gave It To. Elon Musk Wants to Buy What's Left
articles.description: SpaceX's AI division has held internal talks about buying customer records from dead startups—cheap fuel for Grok, no questions asked, because there's nobody left to ask them.

articles.title: Why Is Chipotle Now Working With the CIA-Funded Palantir?
articles.description: Chipotle is piloting a Palantir-built food safety dashboard after a summer of outbreaks, putting employee data in the hands of a company seeded by the CIA's venture arm.

articles.title: CFTC Opens Door for Crypto Apps to Offer Regulated Derivatives Access
articles.description: In a no-action letter, the CFTC said certain software providers can connect users to regulated derivatives markets without registering as brokers.

articles.title: OpenAI Says It's Made Progress on a Second $1 Million Math Problem
articles.description: Days after its disputed Navier-Stokes claim, OpenAI says it's made "substantial progress" on another Millennium Prize math problem—and won't say which one yet.

articles.title: Ethereum Founder Vitalik Buterin Says AI Won’t Doom Crypto Security
articles.description: The Ethereum co-founder said AI could help developers mathematically verify entire software systems, turning the same technology powering new attacks into a tool for defense.

articles.title: Andrew Yang Calls for AI Kill Switch as Safety Fears Mount
articles.description: The former presidential candidate said lawmakers should impose liability rules and waiting periods on frontier AI firms as autonomous agents raise new cyber and labor concerns.

articles.title: King Charles Convenes OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia and Google for AI Safety Summit
articles.description: King Charles hosted senior AI executives at his Scottish estate to discuss keeping the technology "in the service of humanity," days after industry leaders called for a slowdown.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bounces as Markets Brace for the Fed’s Next Move
articles.description: The Federal Reserve's first rate increase since 2023 barely dented crypto prices, but what comes next could change calculations on Wall Street.

articles.title: Financial Data Giant S&P Global Moves Deeper Into Crypto With OpenZeppelin Deal
articles.description: S&P Global is expanding into the technology risks underpinning stablecoins, tokenized funds, and other onchain financial products.

articles.title: FCA Targets Three More London Sites Over Unregistered P2P Crypto Trading
articles.description: "Anyone running an unregistered peer-to-peer crypto business should assume we are looking at them," the FCA's enforcement chief said.

articles.title: SEC Clears a Path for Tokenized Stocks After Clarity Act Stumbles
articles.description: The "innovation exemption" lets qualifying venues trade tokenized versions of U.S. stocks on public blockchains without registering as exchanges—though it excludes price-tracking "synthetics" and lets companies block tokenization of their shares.

articles.title: What Is Arc? The Stablecoin Blockchain From USDC Issuer Circle
articles.description: Arc is a new layer-1 blockchain developed by USDC issuer Circle, designed specifically for stablecoin-native finance.

articles.title: Revolut Hackers Demand $3M Monero Ransom, Threaten to Sell Customer Data: Report
articles.description: The group says it chose whom to target by scanning the blockchain for Revolut accounts holding significant crypto.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds After The Fed’s First Hike Since 2023
articles.description: The Clarity Act failed to pass and FOMC hiked rates, and yet, crypto majors are green and alt leaders are flying. What does it mean?

articles.title: Zcash Closes On $1,400 After Coinholders Vote to Keep Bitcoin-Style Halvings
articles.description: The privacy coin rose double digits Thursday and 168% over the past month in the wake of the NU7 upgrade vote.

articles.title: House Committee Advances US Bitcoin Reserve Bill on Party-Line Split
articles.description: A substitute text adopted before the vote strips out the Federal Reserve funding routes and thins the transparency rules.

articles.title: Crypto Tax Bill Clears House Committee After Clarity Act Setback
articles.description: The bill would exempt qualifying crypto fees from gain-or-loss calculations and restrict tax-loss deductions on tokens sold and quickly repurchased.

articles.title: Meta May Have Found a Fix for Its 'Pervert Glasses'
articles.description: Meta is reportedly developing a version of its smart glasses without a camera, potentially addressing one of the biggest privacy objections to AI wearables.

articles.title: OpenAI's Rogue AI Agents Were Probing Hugging Face Two Months Before Hack
articles.description: An independent researcher found the agents hijacked Hugging Face accounts and mapped the platform's defenses as early as May 13—activity OpenAI's own incident report never fully described.

articles.title: Fed Chair Implies Trump Is Only Half Right on the Economy Following Rate Hike
articles.description: Chair Kevin Warsh credited Trump's economy, then ignored his rate-cut wishes entirely.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core Software Update Aims for Speed and Security Patches
articles.description: Bitcoin Core 32.0 has entered final testing, bringing faster block checks and changes to how wallets prepare payments.

articles.title: Fed Hikes Rates for the First Time Since 2023, Bitcoin Spikes
articles.description: The Federal Reserve delivered the hike Wall Street had almost unanimously priced in.

articles.title: CFTC and SEC Double Down on Crypto After Clarity Act Defeat
articles.description: Michael Selig and Paul Atkins pledged to use their agencies’ existing powers to provide crypto regulatory certainty after the Senate failed to advance the bill.

articles.title: Hackers Hijack HBO Max’s Reddit Account to Spread Crypto-Stealing Malware
articles.description: Attackers ran 108 malicious ads through the streaming service’s verified account, directing users to fake software downloads.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
articles.description: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote
articles.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP ETFs shed roughly $593 million combined Tuesday, their heaviest single-day drawdown since June.

articles.title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as Validators
articles.description: The Layer 1 network’s validator set is permissioned, and Circle has minted 10 billion ARC tokens without committing to publicly launch them.

articles.title: AI Pause Would Help Dominant Firms, Not Safety, Think Tank Warns
articles.description: Cato favors voluntary safeguards, while Block Chairman Jack Dorsey backs independent testing and narrowly justified restrictions.

articles.title: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
articles.description: Overseas firms serving UK retail customers need authorization too, and nobody trades under the new rules before October 2027.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Clarity Act Vote Falls Short as Democrats All Vote ‘No’
articles.description: It should not have come as a surprise given the odds, but crypto majors, alts and memes all sold off anyway in the wake.

articles.title: Bitcoin Hovers at $76K as Analysts Argue the Fed Matters More Than Clarity Act
articles.description: With Bitcoin sitting around $76,000, the argument from analysts is that dollar liquidity, not Congress, sets the floor from here.

articles.title: UK Backs Money Laundering Crackdown With $676M and 500 New Officers
articles.description: The Home Office names crypto alongside fintech and AI as drivers of a threat the NCA puts at £100 billion a year in the UK.

articles.title: Tonkeeper Becomes Keeper as Wallet Adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron
articles.description: The self-custodial wallet is expanding beyond The Open Network, with support for seven blockchains and more financial products planned.

articles.title: Crypto Exchange CoinEx Is Shutting Down After Nine Years, Giving Users Until December to Cash Out
articles.description: The Hong Kong-founded exchange blamed a prolonged crypto winter and rising compliance costs, closing the books on a run that began in December 2017.
